en_quote: Detection system effectiveness increases when organizations leverage all available internal data.
knowledge_zh: 利用所有可用内部数据可提高检测系统有效性

en_quote: Processing large volumes of data requires additional processing power, which increases the speed of the system but may also increase operational costs.
knowledge_zh: 处理大量数据需要额外处理能力，可能增加运营成本

en_quote: AI is useful for identifying anomalous behavior and complex networks when deployed responsibly following sufficient testing.
knowledge_zh: AI在充分测试后负责任部署，可用于识别异常行为和复杂网络。
